# Google Address Validation

The Address Validation API allows developers to verify the accuracy of addresses by validating and standardizing them, and determining their geocode.

Category: Developer. Connect from any WhatEverFi bot at https://whateverfi.com/integrations/google-address-validation/.

## Actions

- **Validate Address** (read-only): Validate and standardize addresses.
- **Provide Validation Feedback**: Provide feedback on an address validation attempt.
